item.title: Counting Down the Top 10 Plays of Ohio State's 2025 Football Season
item.description: Ohio State’s 2025 season came to a disappointing end, but that didn’t mean there weren’t a few fantastic memories along the way. item.description: Two former Ohio State players were included in an eight-player trade between the Dallas Mavericks and Washington Wizards on Wednesday. item.description: Have you ever found yourself wanting a T-shirt that celebrates both Ohio State and Michigan? Today’s your lucky day.
